'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]], [[May 2025 Gaza offensive]]
***At least 100 [[Palestinians]] have been killed in [[Israel]]i strikes on [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] in the last day. [https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-66-people-killed-in-israeli-strikes-on-gaza-women-and-children-among-dead-medics-say-13369334 (Sky News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-airstrike-kills-least-24-gaza-mediators-host-ceasefire-talks-2025-05-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Mogadishu military base bombing]]
***At least 21 people are killed, including the perpetrator, and 15 others are injured in a [[suicide bombing]] at the entrance of a [[military base]] in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mogadishu-suicide-bomber-kills-least-10-army-recruitment-drive-2025-05-18/ (Reuters)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/May/201555/death_toll_climbs_to_20_in_mogadishu_suicide_bombing_claimed_by_al_shabab.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia]] launches 273 [[Loitering munition|drones]] at [[Ukraine]], the largest such attack since the beginning of the war. The attack comes a day after a round of [[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|direct peace talks]] between the two countries, and a day before [[Donald Trump]]'s scheduled call with [[Vladimir Putin]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/may/18/ukraine-reports-largest-drone-attack-from-russia-since-war-began (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Four people are killed and twenty others are injured in a bombing near a market in [[Killa Abdullah District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. Several shops collapsed, fires were started and buildings were damaged. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/pakistan-balochistan-killa-abdullah-market-bomb-blast/article69592770.ece (''The Hindu'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Three [[General Security Service (Syria)|police personnel]] are killed and two others are injured in a [[car bomb]]ing targeting a [[police station]] in [[Mayadin]], [[Deir ez-Zor Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.sana.sy/en/?p=356089 (SANA)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/18/deadly-blast-rocks-police-station-in-eastern-syria-killing-three-report (Al Jazeera English)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Papal inauguration of Pope Leo XIV]]
**The [[papal inauguration]] [[Mass in the Catholic Church|Mass]] of [[Pope Leo XIV]] is held at [[St. Peter's Square]] in [[Vatican City]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/pope-leo-inauguration-live-world-leaders-and-royals-to-attend-event-as-tens-of-thousands-gather-in-vatican-city-13369202 (Sky News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Gulzar Houz fire]]
**Seventeen people are killed and several others are injured in a building fire in [[Hyderabad]], [[Telangana]], [[India]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-building-fire-kills-17-in-hyderabad/a-72581271 (DW)]
*Six people are killed and eleven others are injured in a [[mining accident]] at a [[gold mine]] in Mwakitolyo Village, [[Shinyanga Urban District]], [[Tanzania]]. [https://www.thecitizen.co.tz/tanzania/news/national/six-killed-eleven-rescued-in-tanzania-mine-tragedy-5047192 (The Citizen Tanzania)]
*Three people are killed, including a 5-year-old, and two others are injured, including an infant, when a [[train]] strikes five civilians near a bridge in [[Fremont, Ohio|Fremont]], [[Ohio]], [[United States]]. [https://sanduskyregister.com/news/588364/monday-update-3-dead-in-fremont-train-collision/ (''Sandusky Register'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]], [[2022 Shah Cheragh attack]]
**A court in [[Shiraz]], [[Iran]], sentences three people to death over two attacks on a [[Shia Islam|Shiite]] shrine in 2022 and 2023 in Shiraz and several to others to different prison terms. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/iran-sentences-3-to-death-over-islamic-state-claimed-attacks-on-shiite-shrine-in-shiraz/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Kenya]]n politician [[Martha Karua]], who legally represents incarcerated Tanzanian opposition figure [[Tundu Lissu]], is arrested at [[Julius Nyerere International Airport]] in [[Dar es Salaam]], [[Tanzania]], and set for deportation. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250518-kenyan-politician-lawyer-for-tanzania-opposition-leader-arrested (France 24)]
*[[2025 Bielefeld stabbing attack]]
**Six people are injured, including the perpetrator and one critically, in a [[mass stabbing]] attack when a [[Syria]]n national stabs a group of [[football fans]] with a [[swordstick]] and [[Knife|knives]] outside of a bar in [[Bielefeld]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/05/18/bielefeld-revellers-attacked-outside-a-bar-police-classify-the-offence-as-planned-assault (Euronews)] [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/05/5-injured-in-stabbing-attack-in-germany-syrian-suspect-at-large/ (BNO News)]
*Three people are injured, including an 11-year-old, in a mass stabbing attack outside of a house after an altercation in [[Halle (Saale)|Halle]], [[Saxony-Anhalt]], Germany. [https://www.spiegel.de/panorama/justiz/halle-saale-mann-verletzt-mehrere-menschen-darunter-auch-kinder-a-af3ceea0-55d7-4c90-b38d-e40fd1d3d2a5 (''Der Spiegel'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Polish presidential election]]
**Incumbent [[List of city mayors of Warsaw|mayor of Warsaw]] [[Rafał Trzaskowski]] leads the first round of the [[President of Poland|Polish presidential]] elections with 31.4% of the vote, followed by [[Karol Nawrocki]] with 29.5%. As no candidates received more than 50% of the vote, a [[Two-round system|runoff]] between the two is scheduled for June 1. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/05/18/exit-poll-rafal-trzaskowski-narrowly-wins-polish-presidential-election-first-round (Euronews)] [https://wybory.gov.pl/prezydent2025/en/wynik/pl (Elections of Poland)] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/poland-presidential-elections-2025-what-we-all-know-about-polls-contenders-and-key-decisive-factors/articleshow/121245183.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*[[2025 Portuguese legislative election]]
**Citizens in [[Portugal]] vote to elect 230 seats of the [[Assembly of the Republic (Portugal)|Assembly of the Republic]]. [https://apnews.com/article/portugal-election-politics-a7ad09455b14af8eb7722ac0008d96ed (AP)]
*[[2025 Romanian presidential election]]
**[[Romanian people|Romanians]] vote in the second round to choose their [[President of Romania|president]] between far-right [[George Simion]] and [[Independent politician|independent]]-declared centrist and incumbent [[Mayor of Bucharest|Bucharest mayor]] [[Nicușor Dan]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/romania-election-polls-open-in-tight-presidential-runoff/live-72578992 (DW)]
**Nicușor Dan is elected [[President of Romania]] after winning 53.6% of the vote. [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/05/18/romanian-centrist-dan-poised-to-win-presidency-over-hard-right-rival.html (CNBC)] [https://www.dw.com/en/romania-election-pro-eu-centrist-nicusor-dan-wins-runoff/live-72578992 (DW)]
*[[2025 South Korean presidential election]]
**[[Liberal Unification Party]] [[president of South Korea|presidential]] candidate Koo Joo-wa resigns from his candidacy for the upcoming presidential election on June 3. [https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20250518040100001#:~:text=%EC%B5%9C%EC%8B%A0%EB%89%B4%EC%8A%A4-,%EC%9E%90%EC%9C%A0%ED%86%B5%EC%9D%BC%EB%8B%B9,-%EA%B5%AC%EC%A3%BC%EC%99%80%20%EB%8C%80%EC%84%A0%20%ED%9B%84%EB%B3%B4 (Yonhap <small>(in Korean)</small>)]
**Former [[People Power Party (South Korea)|People Power Party]] lawmaker [[Kim Sang-wook (politician)|Kim Sang-wook]] joins the [[Democratic Party (South Korea, 2015)|Democratic Party of Korea]], three days after he declared support for [[Lee Jae-myung]] as the party's presidential candidate and ten days after leaving the conservative party. [https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10489790 (''The Korea Herald'')]
*The party of [[Argentina]]'s president, [[Javier Milei]], [[La Libertad Avanza]], wins the [[Buenos Aires]] legislative election, with presidential spokesman [[Manuel Adorni]] securing the victory. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentinas-milei-wins-show-support-buenos-aires-election-2025-05-18/ (Reuters)]

*[[2024–25 Premier League]]

**In [[women's association football]],  [[Chelsea F.C. Women|Chelsea]] complete a [[Treble (association football)|domestic treble]] after beating [[Manchester United W.F.C.|Man United]] 3–0 in the [[Women's FA Cup]] [[2025 Women's FA Cup final|final]]. **In [[motorsports]], [[Robert Shwartzman]] of [[Prema Racing]] wins [[pole position]] for the [[Indianapolis 500]], the first [[rookie]] to do so since 1983. [https://www.thestar.com/sports/auto-racing/shwartzman-shocks-the-field-as-he-becomes-1st-indy-500-rookie-since-1983-to-win/article_9e847a1d-fa86-5fdc-97e1-30dc942a062a.html (AP via ''Toronto Star'')]
